summary: Six cheque dishonour cases under Section 138 Negotiable Instruments Act from same transaction; two filed at Nagpur, four at New Delhi; contention over territorial jurisdiction under Section 142(2) NI Act; non obstante clause in Section 142(1) does not bar transfer under Section 406 Cr.P.C.; interest of justice favours consolidated trial; all cases to be tried together at New Delhi; transfer allowed.
legal_provisions_cited: K. Bhaskaran v. Sankaran Vaidhyan Balan
Dashrath Rupsingh Rathod v. State of Maharashtra
Bridgestone India Pvt. Ltd. v. Inderpal Singh
final_judgment: Transfer petitions allowed; complaint cases SCC Nos.25668/2019 and 26875/2019 transferred to Dwarka Courts, New Delhi for joint trial with pending cases there.
